name: challenge-ranking-v1
exposure_disclosure: Developer-authored diagnostic corpus with prior exposure of every split during corpus validation and the challenge-prompts-v1 experiment. The earlier source-v3 test score of 0/8 was known when this scoring experiment was designed. This experiment fixes an unweighted difference between mean candidate token log-likelihood with the task hint and with an empty hint, using the same source-v3 prompt. No examples, weights or parameters are fitted. The scoring rule, reference construction, approaches and tie rule are fixed before the new train and validation comparisons. Validation alone selects an approach; its test run starts only after selection is saved. Neither independent authorship, an unseen test nor a model usefulness claim is asserted.
